page.layout: One printed page: running head at top (left "Cap. 10." and centred-left "Jugulum Causæ.", right page number 197); one text column of justified running text; at the foot a signature "N 3" at left-centre and the catchword-like word "ricorum" at right, which is the last word of the last line and is therefore part of the text. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Id etiam fidem facit accedere authoritatem dogmatibus secundæ Classis non primæ ab imperio Papali divitiis florenti, quod cum sint dogmata primæ Classis difficiliora cognitu altiorisque contemplationis; secundæ vero Classis Δεύτερα aut materia de illis sint magis obviæ & expositæ intelligentiæ, & pene ad captum rudiorum, in his tamen turpiter sem-per erraverint Romanenses; in illis vero plerumque sana docuerint & retinuerint, saltem super eis elucidationes & enodationes rationi consonas ediderint: quod docet ultrò & destinatò Romanenses cespitare in plana via doctrinarum secundæ Classis: atque à sua cuique utilitate aliqua commoveri & abripi ad arripienda ea secundæ Classis dogmata; nempe quia magis faciunt ad supportandum Papæ imperium & augendam rem familiarem: id clarius fiet per collationem Patrum imprimis Justini Martyris ad Doctores Romanenses hodiernos, reputando illos in dogmatibus difficilioribus & altioris intellectûs graviter cespitavisse, qualia sunt dogmata primæ Classis; at saniores extitisse in dogmatibus secundæ Classis: eam potissimam ob causam, quod viris sanctis solenne fuerit caligare ad sublimia & difficilioris intelligentiæ, adeoque pronus fuerit lapsus ad errorem; at recta senserint in dogmatibus secundæ Classis quæ sunt facilioris intellectûs, ut sunt doctrinæ de Sacramentis, de statu mortuorum post hanc vitam, de cultu aut Dei aut creaturarum, de confessione peccatorum, de matrimonio clericorum

page.notes: The Greek word after "Classis" is partly illegible in the scan; transcribed as best possible. Right-hand word "ricorum" is the end of the last line, placed at right beside the signature. Some letters in the body are blurred (e.g. "Papali", "cespitare") but were read with reasonable confidence. The "2" and marks in the right margin are stray marks, not text.
